summary: Iteration 263 — Verified the EXTENSION of Qoyod identity diagnostics that addresses the user's production complaint (10 products with empty names + system SKUs like cod_item/custom_product). Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_qoyod_identity_diagnostics.py = 32/32 PASS in 0.06s (was 11 in iter262), including the critical new tests: test_user_scenario_empty_name_and_system_products (literal AMS11903/cod_item/custom_product/shipping_express repro), 8 test_extract_name_* fallback-chain tests (name → arabic_name → english_name → name_ar → name_en → display_name → title → localizations[0].name), 11 parametrized test_is_system_product tests (cod_item, custom_product, shipping_fee, delivery_fee, discount_item, fees_item, shipping_*, system_* TRUE; AMS11903, empty, normal-sku FALSE), test_is_system_product_uses_reference_when_sku_missing, test_raw_rows_returns_all_up_to_limit, test_raw_rows_caps_each_row_at_50_keys, test_name_source_tells_which_field_was_used. Full Qoyod regression: pytest tests/test_qoyod_*.py = 454 passed / 2 skipped / 0 failed in 9.90s — NO regressions. Live HTTP: GET /api/integrations/qoyod/diagnostics/identity returns 200 with the new shape — products.raw_rows=[] and customers.raw_rows=[] keys present alongside meta/sample/raw_first_row, qoyod_unauthorized error block intact, api_key_fingerprint='08cef7386398' (sha256[:12]), endpoint='GET /products?page=1&limit=10'. Frontend QYD-GO page: all required testids render (qoyod-identity-diagnostics-card, btn-run-identity-diag, diag-mezan-fingerprint, diag-products, diag-customers, diag-confirm-identity); qoyod_unauthorized rose-text shown for both sections. The conditional testids (diag-products-raw, diag-customers-raw, diag-product-row-0, diag-product-system-badge-0) are correctly ABSENT in the live preview because the admin tenant's Qoyod key returns 401 — the spec explicitly says these only render when products/customers .ok=true. Source-code review confirms all the rendering paths are wired exactly per spec: bg-slate-50 row background when p.is_system, italic '— (لا يوجد اسم في أي حقل)' placeholder when !p.name, small ({name_source}) annotation in text-slate-500 when name_source !== 'name', 'نظامي' badge with title tooltip and bg-slate-200 styling, <details open> with bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 max-h-96 overflow-auto, JSON.stringify of FULL raw_rows array (not just first row). Code review of identity_diagnostics.py confirms _SYSTEM_SKU_EXACT covers 6 SKUs (cod_item, custom_product, shipping_fee, delivery_fee, discount_item, fees_item) and _SYSTEM_SKU_PREFIXES covers 5 (shipping_, delivery_, fees_, tax_, system_) — matches spec exactly. _extract_name traversal matches spec ordering. _raw_rows caps 50 keys per row and 10 rows max. No lint issues.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 263 validates the user-RCA extension: empty names now triaged via name_source field (which of 8 fallback fields produced the value, or null if blank everywhere) and system/shadow SKUs (cod_item, custom_product, shipping_*, delivery_*, fees_*, tax_*, system_*) are flagged with is_system=true and rendered with 'نظامي' badge + slate row background. Full raw_rows (up to 10, each ≤50 keys) are dumped JSON to <details open> for ground-truth field discovery. The admin@hesab.app preview tenant's Qoyod key is still in 401 unauthorized state, so the success-branch UI does NOT render live — that branch is covered by the 32 pytest tests including the user-scenario repro. To see tables/badges live, a tenant with a valid scoped Qoyod key on /products is required.
rca of the issue: User's production data showed 10 products with mostly empty 'name' fields and system SKUs (cod_item, custom_product, AMS11903, custom-numeric SKUs) bleeding into the catalogue view. RCA implemented: (1) name extraction now traverses 8 Qoyod field variants in deterministic priority order — name_source surfaces WHICH field was used or null when truly empty, so the operator can immediately tell whether Qoyod is sending the name under arabic_name/localizations/title instead of 'name'; (2) is_system flag computed from SKU/reference against an explicit allowlist (6 exact + 5 prefixes), letting the operator distinguish real catalogue products (AMS11903) from system/shadow rows (cod_item, custom_product, shipping_express) without manual cross-reference; (3) raw_rows dumps the verbatim first 10 rows (each ≤50 keys) so any future hidden field can be diagnosed without code changes. All three RCA outputs are visible inline as the user requested (full JSON of products + reason name is empty + system flag), implemented + tested + lint-clean.
